notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 0.7% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, QQQ has underperformed SPY by about 2.2 percentage points.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 1.0% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, VXUS has underperformed SPY by about 3.5 percentage points.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 2.1% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Over the last 20 trading days, MU has underperformed SPY by about 12.4 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 1.6%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 2.7% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Earnings are about 8 days away and should be considered when choosing an expiration.
Over the last 20 trading days, INTC has underperformed SPY by about 23.5 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.3%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 5.3% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.

Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.3%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 2.8% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

guidance.note: Candidates are ranked from current execution quality plus historical replay and validated evidence. They are not guaranteed future-return estimates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

guidance.note: Candidates are ranked from current execution quality plus historical replay and validated evidence. They are not guaranteed future-return estimates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

guidance.note: No contract currently clears the full quality, execution and historical-evidence gates.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

notes: Model output is not a calibrated real-world probability.
Compare signal lift with the unconditional base rate; the lift interval uses paired moving-block bootstrap resampling to reflect base-rate uncertainty and some serial dependence.
Give more weight to signals only when validation and sample size support them.

news_signal.method: Freshness × source quality × relevance × novelty, with bounded headline-direction lexicon. News is a context modifier, not a standalone trade signal.

company_context.news_note: Recent headlines are scored as a bounded catalyst/context modifier using freshness, source quality, relevance and novelty. News alone cannot create a BUY candidate.

plain_language: The directional model has not shown strong out-of-sample discrimination, so its probability should receive limited weight.
Comparable historical signals are not clearly separated from the ticker's normal base rate, so the current signal adds limited directional evidence.
Earnings are about 13 days away and should be considered when choosing an expiration.
Over the last 20 trading days, SMCI has underperformed SPY by about 21.3 percentage points.
Recent earnings dates in the available history produced an average absolute next-session move of about 2.9%.
The nearest-expiration at-the-money straddle is pricing a move of roughly 8.3% of the stock price, before transaction costs.

options.status: Historical distribution + fallback option snapshot active

chain.quote_note: Quotes are selected per contract by provider quality, feed authority, freshness, and cross-provider agreement. A newer indicative/delayed quote cannot override a trustworthy consolidated real-time quote.

opportunity_radar.method_note: Today's contract economics replayed across historical underlying moves. Profit-frequency uncertainty and qualification use an overlap-adjusted effective sample count because multi-day forward returns overlap. Results are hypothetical, exclude changing historical IV/Greeks and are not a profitability guarantee.

errors.error: Not enough rows for requested walk-forward window.

readiness.note: Only forward paper trades from the current strategy using real-time entry data count. Passing these checks does not guarantee future profitability or authorize real-money trading.

forward_validation.note: Reference profit frequency and expected payoff come from evidence captured before entry. Forward realized outcomes are the primary validation record.

attribution.note: Attribution uses current-strategy, real-time-source trades and facts captured at entry. Small samples should not be treated as evidence of a durable edge.

learning.note: Learning uses only current-strategy trades entered from real-time data. It remains disabled until the minimum forward sample is reached; eligible adjustments are capped at ±10% and never rewrite prior decisions.
